implementation: nextTabStop, placeTab and decimalIndex in packages/model/src/spacing/tabs.ts
description: Tab stops measured from the left margin: explicit stops, the hanging-indent stop, default stops, alignment of the segment after the tab, and leaders.
format: `tabs` are the paragraph's resolved stops in position order, `indentLeft` and `indentFirstLine` its indents (0 when absent), `defaultTabStop` the setting (720 when absent), `x` the position of the tab in twips from the left margin, and `segment` the text after it (its width and, for a decimal stop, the width before the first separator). `expected` gives the stop (`position`, `align`, `leader`, `source`: stop, hanging or default), where the segment starts (`start`) and, for decimal stops, the index of the separator in the segment's `text` (`decimalIndex`).

cases.description: A left stop starts the segment at the stop.
A right stop ends the segment at the stop; the leader fills from the current position.
A centre stop centres the segment on the stop (half the width rounded down).
A decimal stop puts the first decimal separator at the stop ("1234.56": 400 twips before the separator).
A segment without a decimal separator ends at a decimal stop, as at a right stop.
A segment that does not fit before a right stop starts at the current position.
Without stops, a tab goes to the next multiple of defaultTabStop strictly to the right.
At a multiple of defaultTabStop, a tab goes to the next one.
One twip before a multiple, a tab goes to that multiple.
Default stops to the left of an explicit stop are cleared.
After the last explicit stop, the default stops continue at multiples from the margin.
With a hanging indent, the left indent is a left stop; at a tie it wins over the default stop.
The hanging-indent stop does not clear the default stops before it.
A label that ends beyond the hanging indent goes to the next default stop.
Stops are measured from the left margin, not from the indent: a stop at 720 lies left of a line starting at 1440.
An explicit stop nearer than the hanging-indent stop wins.
